knobs.note: Read by bin/fly-image-refresh.sh as ${CLI_DRIFT_MAX_PATCH:-3}: after a project's builder image is rebuilt, its baked claude/codex CLI (state/fly/<project>.cli, written by bin/fly-image-build.sh) is compared against the hub's cli.claude_code.version / cli.codex.version settings rows (written by bin/cli-update.sh after the hub's own daily update, BH-1517). A builder more than this many patch versions behind either floor writes one ALERTS.log line per project per UTC day. Registered by BH-1517, the change that introduced the read.
